blocks.text: You can integrate DSPM with your Azure Blob Storage. This integration enables DSPM to send the alert data logs of your cloud resources to the Azure Blob Storage containers for storage and data analysis by third-party SIEM or ITSM tools.
Only users with the administrator role can configure a cloud storage integration.
To configure the Azure Blob Storage integration:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > DSPM Integrations.
Click Add next to the Cloud Storage integration.
See image.
The Add Cloud Storage Integration page appears.
On the Add Integration page, under Integrations Details:
Integration Name: Enter a unique name.
Cloud Storage: Select Azure Blob Storage.
See image.
Click Next.
Under Cloud Storage, complete the following steps to provide DSPM with write permissions on Azure Blob Storage:
Copy the connection string from the Azure portal.
Log in to the Azure portal.
Go to your storage account.
Under Security > Networking, select Access Key.

Click Show Keys to view your access keys and connection strings. A connection string includes the authorization information required for DSPM to access data in your Azure Storage account. To learn more, refer to the Azure Blob Storage documentation.
Copy the entire connection string for the relevant access key.
Azure Storage Account Connection String: Paste the connection string you copied from the Azure portal.
(Optional) Container Location: Enter the location of the storage container. It is mandatory to first create a folder in your Azure Blob Storage and then add the name.
Test Connection: Click to verify the connection between DSPM and the Azure Blob Storage. A message is displayed indicating the connection is verified.
See image.
Click Next.
Review the integration summary. Click the Edit icon if you want to make any changes.
See image.
Click Finish.

blocks.text: You can see the integration details on the Integrations page. The initial status is shown as Pending because data is not yet sent to the Azure Blob Storage. You must configure and associate the alert notification rules with this integration for DSPM to be able to send the data logs. When DSPM sends the data logs to the Blob Storage, then the status changes to Success.
